# Introduction {#sec-intro}

The current report focuses on the Chinese muntjak (print name), a small deer species native to China and Taiwan.
The Chinese muntjac is invasive in the UK, Belgium (Flanders) and France and is listed as a species of Union Concern under the EU Invasive Alien Species Regulation [@noauthor_regulation_2014].

In Flanders, it is in an earlier invasion stage, with an established population with a distribution currently likely limited to parts of the Antwerp province.
The Flanders population is one of the few known populations on the European mainland, which gives the region a particular responsibility to act.
Effective containment and eradication here could prevent further spread into other climatically suitable regions across Europe, aligning Flemish efforts with broader EU biosecurity goals.
